name: Hiiragi Shiori
source:
Hobbies: Watching YuoTube.
Favorite foods: Candies and marshmallows.

"I didn't mean it like that. But every time I noticed, I ended up being alone."

She is a 1st year at Kazami Academy and a part of the Active Club.

She essentially expressionless and doesn't have much of a reaction.
She absentmindedly looks at the sky, plants, and animals all by herself.
It's not like she has a cold personality. She has a frivolous existence because her class has a tough time approaching her.

As she was dozing around the place where Hibiki was dancing, she joined the Active Club based on the flow that was going on.

She seems to have a favorite YuoTube channel to watch and often checks those videos during break time.

[Translated from [url=http://sagaplanets.product.co.jp/works/kakenuke/index.html]Official Website[/url]]
